chapter_theme: The three gunas and the gunaless (முக்குண நிர்க்குணம்): the states of the soul are matched with the gunas, sattva with waking, rajas with dream, tamas with deep sleep, while turiya is the stainless state beyond all three.

2296.reading: When sattva is said to belong to waking, rajas is held to be dream and tamas deep sleep; the gunaless state that puts an end to them is stainless turiya.
2296.nuance: The mapping of the gunas onto the states is the verse's own. ஒய்த்திடும் is an unusual form, perhaps 'that wears down' or 'that stills', and மாய்த்திடும் (that destroys) can belong either to the gunaless state or to turiya.

links.note: 2296 maps sattva, rajas and tamas onto waking, dream and deep sleep and makes the gunaless state stainless turiya; 2538 says that when the states from waking are let go, unattached to the birth-bound malas and gunas (மலங்குணம் பற்றற்று), the twofold turiya becomes the true form. 2538 turns 2296's map into a practice of release.
